segments.content:
Chapter 15 Song Xiyun: If Only I Hadn't Called Him That. And a Desperate Need to Spend Money.

Jiang Nian was truly speechless. He had just run into a clueless woman.

Dealing with a moronic receptionist was one thing, but after finally finding a female trainer who had just switched jobs, she turned out to be a piece of wood that would only jump when poked.

Apologies? Is that all you know how to do?

With your level of sales skills, you'd get slaughtered in Japan! Service comes first, so just say the magic words already! Shivering with anger, how infuriating! I even have to take the initiative when I'm the one spending money!

Zhao Qiuxue was dazed and subconsciously uttered a single word.

"Huh?"

"Damn it!" Jiang Nian cursed.

The irritable Jiang Nian was finally no longer irritable. Xu Qianqian, wearing a curious expression, turned back to ask before opening the security door to her home.

"Why are you so happy tonight?"

"Oh, I found some money."

"Weirdo."

The door slammed shut with a bang.

Xu Qianqian's foot injury had healed a lot, and she could apply the medicinal rub herself. It didn't matter if she used less pressure when massaging it; it would be better in a day or two anyway.

Old Xu called. Another business trip.

Xu Qianqian hung up the phone with a calm expression and walked into the empty apartment. After washing up, she sat in the living room in her thin pajamas, humming a song as she applied the ointment.

As she applied it, tears began to fall, patter, patter.

At a food stall on Jiaoyu Road.

Song Xiyun met up with her mother, Zhao Qiuxue, right after evening self-study for a rare late-night snack. She had already resolved to start pinching pennies from now on.

Since her mother had been laid off, she had to bear some of the family's responsibility.

However...

"Yunyun, Mom made a sale on her first day at the new job. Impressive, right!"

"Huh?" Song Xiyun looked shocked, her expression identical to the sweating yellow emoji. "Didn't you just quit today? What first day at a new job?"

"I switched jobs." Zhao Qiuxue stuck out her tongue and boasted, "It was one of Mom's old clients. I brought them over."

"Give me a break. Your sales record was zero."

Zhao Qiuxue: Sulking.

Song Xiyun slapped her forehead. "Mom, just tell me the truth. I can help you think it over."

"I'm the adult. What's a little kid like you going to help me think over?" Zhao Qiuxue tried to reclaim her maternal dignity, but it was utterly useless.

Seeing her daughter still staring at her, Zhao Qiuxue had no choice but to recount what happened that evening in full detail.

"Don't you think that handsome young man was strange? Not only did he get the 998 yuan membership card, he also bought thirty sessions at one hundred yuan each. It all added up to a full four thousand yuan, so expensive..."

Listening to her mother's rambling, Song Xiyun's vision went dark.

"Mom, what's the name of the person who gave you the sale?"

"Oh, you mean that handsome young man? Jiang Nian~~~ I hear he's a third-year high school student. I advised him not to buy the sessions since he wouldn't have time for them, but he insisted."

The combination of those two words completely broke Song Xiyun's already bent back.

"How could it be him!"

"Yunyun, you know that handsome young man?" Zhao Qiuxue asked curiously.

"No, I don't!" Song Xiyun said in horror. She remembered calling him "Dad" during the day to liven things up. Now, it had really come back to bite her like a boomerang.

She made up her mind to find a chance to ask him about it tomorrow.

At the same time.

Jiang Nian was gleefully staring at his bank account balance again and again. For some reason, Zhou Haifei had given up on the idea for the morning's mission.

Perhaps it was due to the temporal displacement. The Zhou Haifei from twenty years later and the Zhou Haifei of now were not the same person. After all, people's thoughts can change.

He wasn't going to the gym, not in the slightest. As for reselling the membership, he had no plans for that at the moment either. Who knew how the system judged these things? If he sold it right after the money arrived, the system might just deduct the money again.

In any case, trading four thousand for twenty thousand was a massive profit.

He currently had 23,000 yuan in his account. A week ago, he was just a broke third-year high school student who could only scrape together three hundred yuan. Now, he was suddenly rich.

His ego a bit inflated, Jiang Nian tossed and turned, unable to sleep. He got up for a drink of water in the middle of the night and found his parents in the living room with the light on, recording accounts on a laptop while talking.

Li Hongmei had a worried frown, whispering something to Old Jiang. The moment Jiang Nian came out of his room and asked curiously, his mom shot him down with a stern face.

"Go on, go on. Why's a kid meddling in so much? Go to sleep, you have school tomorrow."

"Alrighty then." Jiang Nian readily complied.

The system mission hadn't refreshed yet. After a quick look, he went back to his room and fell asleep.

The next day.

"Is your foot better?" Jiang Nian brought Xu Qianqian breakfast as usual and shot her a suspicious glance. "Hey, why are your eyes red?"

Xu Qianqian had already washed up and was waiting for him in the living room. At his words, she turned her head away unnaturally.

She was too embarrassed to say that while applying ointment by herself at home yesterday, she started thinking about her mom and couldn't help but cry. She cried all night after returning to her room, soaking her pillow.

"I... I just didn't sleep well."

"Oh, oh. You haven't applied the rub yet, right? Let me help you." Jiang Nian crouched down and searched for the bottle of medicated wine. "Where did you put it after using it yesterday? You didn't throw it out, did you?"

"I can do it myself." Xu Qianqian lowered her head and touched her ankle, pressing it gently. "It's almost healed. I don't think it needs any more."

Jiang Nian ignored her, grabbed her foot, and pulled it over.

Her calf was fair and well-proportioned, cool to the touch. The taut muscle traced a beautiful curve. Her delicate sole flashed by as all five of her toes curled up.

"I told you, you don't have to..." she mumbled.

"We're going to be late, or else you think I enjoy this?" Jiang Nian reached out and poked the sole of her foot lightly. Xu Qianqian instantly let out a soft cry, and her toes curled even tighter.

"Ah~~" Jiang Nian mimicked her cry.

Xu Qianqian immediately blushed. "Are you trying to get yourself killed! Jiang Nian!"

Walking on the road, Xu Qianqian's face was still a little red, and a faint warmth seemed to linger on her ankle.

It wasn't until they were climbing the stairs of the academic building that she remembered.

"Are you confident about the English exam?"

The stairs were crowded with people, most of them rushing to class at the last minute. Jiang Nian only had time to turn his head and say one word.

"Probably."

Ring ring ring!!!

The bell for class rang, and a sound like a zombie horde on the run erupted from downstairs. The area below the academic building was like the end of the world, with students around them running frantically.

Xu Qianqian opened her mouth to say something, but was ultimately separated by the human tide.

The first period was math. Jiang Nian propped his head on his hand as he listened. His eyelids drooped, and his mind felt drowsy. It was all because he'd been too excited last night about the extra twenty thousand in his account.

That delicate young woman had even added him on WeChat. Jiang Nian felt that was hardly necessary.

Yawn~~ So sleepy.

For third-year high school students, being hit with two math classes first thing at eight in the morning was simply hell on earth.

He finally made it through to the third period, English class. The English teacher arrived late, holding a stack of answer sheets, but there wasn't a trace of a smile on her face.

The class wasn't afraid of the English teacher, so their reactions weren't extreme, but they still quieted down to show her respect.

"This exam... ahem." The English teacher was a young woman in her thirties who wore a different outfit every day, and the bag on her lectern was worth over ten thousand yuan.

"Was very poor. Only three people scored above one hundred and thirty!"

Thank you to Big Boss Wen Ba for the 1000 Qidian coin donation. Wishing the boss a healthy back and kidneys.

(End of Chapter)
